answer: Funding-origin clustering makes each extra fake earn less. The meadow is the epoch reward pool, split per key, except keys whose first deposit came from the same funding address share one slice. The vine is that funding chain, traced 3 hops on the public ledger, and jade is the 25 POA a key must hold from an independent source to leave its cluster. 1,000 fakes funded from one wallet earn a single slice, so splitting them costs 1,000 x 25 POA jade = 25,000 POA. Attacker pays: 25,000 POA.
